payload.summary: PLAN_REVIEW round 6 converges. Revision 6 closes the last schema-version, Unicode maxLength, and audit/terminal zero-ID findings. No critical or non-blocking defects remain. External vendor transmission remains unauthorized, so cross-vendor quorum was unavailable, but the validated local review has no blocking findings.

Produced a no-blocker structured findings artifact, consensus, manifest, and phase handoff.
